sentiment.instructions: These are Kosovo-Albanian (Gheg dialect) social media comments on daily COVID-19 updates from the health institute (IKSHPK). Judge the commenter's overall attitude toward the situation, the authorities, or the numbers. Classify by the dominant emotional stance, not by the topic alone.

criteria.positive: Praise, thanks, blessings, relief or hope: thanking health workers, wishing recovery, relief at falling cases, approving the government or the public. Cues: ju lumt (well done), faleminderit (thank you), respekt, shërim të shpejt (speedy recovery), elhamdulilah/shyqyr (thank God), inshallah (God willing), bravo, hajde ma gjall të shërum (come on, more recovered), pa lodhshme (tireless). Light jokes cheering progress also count as positive, as does a bare friend tag paired with a well-wish like 'urime' (congratulations).
criteria.neutral: Bare name tags with nothing else; factual questions (which municipality, which neighbourhood); posted statistics; neutral observations or jokes about numbers ('ja nisi apet' = it started again); requests or suggestions for stricter measures or testing; a personal account plus a calm appeal to be careful; mild puzzlement ('pak e çuditshme' = a bit strange) without accusation.
criteria.negative: Anger, insults, accusations or contempt: claiming the numbers are lies or faked, blaming or demanding resignation of the government/ministers (Zemaj, Hoti), insulting citizens who ignore rules, boredom/disgust with the reports, sarcasm. Cues: rrena/rreni/rrejt (lies/you lie), mashtrim (deception), budall (idiots), turp (shame), qaf na morret (you've ruined us), jeni ba bajat (you've become stale), copy paste, hupët kontrollen (lost control), dorëheqje (resignation).
